node.label: Tay-Sachs disease AB variant
node.definition: GM2 gangliosidosis, AB variant is an extremely rare, severe genetic disorder characterized by progressive neurological decline due to ganglioside activator deficiency.

No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.22. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no shared specific pathway between the causal genes.
